programmes.title: Flavors[Can/Eng]
programmes.description:
在阿爾卑斯山與普羅旺斯之間的薰衣草田、中世紀村莊、壯麗峽谷與山地高原，人們延續陶藝、芝士、香草、葡萄酒、菇菌與橄欖的傳統，也適應不斷轉變的氣候和鄉郊生活。從古堡到高地，都由自然、歷史與工藝共同塑造。
 Between the Alps and Provence, this journey explores a region of lavender fields, medieval villages, dramatic gorges and mountain plateaus. Farmers, artisans and growers keep alive traditions of pottery, cheese, herbs, wine, mushrooms and olives, while adapting to climate change and changing rural life. From ancient castles to wild highlands, the landscape reveals a land shaped by nature, history and enduring craft.

programmes.title: Taiwan Built In A Day[Can/Man]

programmes.title: Taiwan Built In A Day[Can/Man]

programmes.description:
多斯探索機場附近的密西沙加南亞飲食界。他找來大廚馬蒂馬西森去吃正宗的喀拉拉食物，品嘗創新旁遮普—加拿大風味美食和傳統的咖喱角；從而揭示食物如何連繫不同世代，及促成充滿味道、傳統和歸屬感的非凡社區。
 Suresh Doss explores Mississauga’s vibrant South Asian food scene near Toronto Pearson Airport. Joined by chef Matty Matheson, he discovers authentic Kerala cuisine, innovative Punjabi-Canadian dishes, and traditional samosas. Through family-run restaurants, cherished recipes, and bustling Ridgeway Plaza, the journey reveals how food connects generations and transforms neighbourhoods into extraordinary destinations.

 We explore the spectacular landscapes, wildlife, and cultural heritage of northern and central Australia. From Kakadu National Park's wetlands and ancient Aboriginal rock art to Katherine Gorge's dramatic cliffs, the journey reveals nature's extraordinary adaptations. Discover Litchfield's waterfalls, Mount Isa's mining industry, desert wildlife, Coober Pedy's underground homes, and the sacred wonders of Kata Tjuta and Uluru.
